summary: Building ForgeML, the internal MLOps platform data scientists train, scan and deploy models on.
description: Cut model deployment from 3 days to 30 minutes for 15+ data scientists by building multi-target deployment orchestration across Databricks Serving, AKS and edge devices.
Architected ForgeML as 8 microservices and 30+ FastAPI endpoints covering training, model registry, security scanning, deployment and monitoring for multi-tenant workloads.
Fine-tuned Gemini on Vertex AI to translate SkySpark Axon rules into Honeywell Forge DSL, reaching 80%+ accuracy with automated job submission and status polling.
Halved write latency on an Azure Event Hub pipeline using concurrent dual writes to PostgreSQL and Unity Catalog, with exactly-once delivery via Blob checkpointing.
Caught 40+ vulnerabilities before deployment by integrating 5 security scanners behind a Strategy Pattern, alongside JWT RS256 auth and OPA policy enforcement.
Built a BDD acceptance suite in Behave with parallel multi-tenant execution and Locust load tests, covering onboarding through deployment end to end.

summary: Built the Databricks pipelines that fed field service analytics and the Maintenance Assist chatbot.
description: Built 15+ PySpark ingestion pipelines on Databricks from SQL Server, Salesforce, SharePoint and REST APIs into Delta Lake, using watermark-based incremental loading.
Engineered a Spark Structured Streaming pipeline for PDFs landing in Blob Storage, applying SCD Type 2 upserts to track document changes across micro-batches.
Powered the Maintenance Assist LLM chatbot by building its document vectorization pipeline into PGVector, plus an eval framework using Azure OpenAI as judge.
Kept the serving database in sync with batched Delta to PostgreSQL upserts using ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, avoiding full table reloads.
Wired Change Data Feed on Delta tables to trigger downstream vectorization jobs on incremental inserts, updates and deletes.
Wrote SQL transformation pipelines producing weekly, monthly and quarterly field service analytics consumed by the customer-facing DSP dashboard.
